note_001.Title: Code For Sterile Corridor
note_001.Body: Mr. Harolds, I am so sorry. I tried to wake you. I can’t carry you out alone and I don’t have any time left to wait. I don’t know what’s happening but you can’t stay in this room.  All remaining staff and patients are falling back to the Sterile Corridor. The door code is 4458. When you wake up from the anesthesia, come find us immediately. -Dr Shayla
